newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGAS RAUGS Q1 AFTER TAX PROFIT 28,000 LATS.
newsitem.headline: RIGAS RAUGS Q1 AFTER TAX PROFIT 28,000 LATS.

text.p: Riga Raugs yeast factory said on Monday that its first quarter after-tax profit was slightly higher than planned at 28,000 lats against 41,000 lats in the same period of 1996.
"Our after-tax profit for the first quarter is 28,000 lats, which is some 3,000 lats more than budgeted," Nikolai Kornilov, manager of Rigas Raugs, told Reuters.
"We are working normally as we hope to do also in the coming quarters and continuing with our investment programme," Kornilov said.
Raugs, quoted on the secondary list of the stock exchange, earlier reported a 1996 profit of 187,000 lats on turnover of 1.3 million lats.
